name: Coalesced Little Mods
author: Oddisz
description: Eight of Oddisz's small mods in one: Cloning, Rev. Eng. Private Arsenal, StopBloatingMe, StopStackingMe, Intel Renewed, Hullmods - Renewed, Gambling Den and StarterPack. Cloning, Private Arsenal and Gambling Den each have an on/off switch in the LunaLib settings, on by default. Replaces the separate versions of these mods: disable those before enabling this one.
